TheoryOperatorType ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of theory operator types.

Unary class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Unary = 0

A unary operator.

BinaryLeft class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

BinaryLeft = 1

A left-associative binary operator.

BinaryRight class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

BinaryRight = 2

A right-associative binary operator.

TheoryAtomType ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of theory atom types.

Head class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Head = 0

A theory atom that may only occur in rule heads.

Body class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Body = 1

A theory atom that may only occur in rule bodies.

Any class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Any = 2

A theory atom that may occur in rule heads and bodies.

Directive class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Directive = 3

A theory atom that may only occur in the head of a rule with an empty body.

OptimizeType ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of optimization types.

Minimize class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Minimize = 0

A #minimize statement.

Maximize class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Maximize = 1

A #maximize statement.

IncludeType ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of include types.

System class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

System = 0

An include of a file, for example #include "file.lp".

Inbuild class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Inbuild = 1

An include of a built-in program, for example #include <incmode>.

Precedence ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of precedences of definitions.

Default class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Default = 0

A definition providing a default value ([default]).

Override class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Override = 1

A definition overriding a default value ([override]).

CommentType ¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of comment types.

Line class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Line = 0

A line comment starting with %.

Block class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

Block = 1

A block comment enclosed in %* and *%.

visit ¶

visit(
    visitor: Callable[..., object],
    *args: object,
    **kwargs: object
) -> None

Call the visitor with each child node.

Child nodes are the arguments of the node that hold nodes. Elements of sequences are visited one by one and absent optional nodes are skipped.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default
visitor Callable[..., object]

The function to call with each child node followed by the additional arguments.

 required
args object

Additional positional arguments passed to the visitor.

 ()
kwargs object

Additional keyword arguments passed to the visitor.

 {}

transform ¶

transform(
    lib: Library,
    transformer: Callable[..., AST | None],
    *args: object,
    **kwargs: object
) -> Self | None

Transform the child nodes of the node.

The transformer is called with each child node (see visit). If it returns a node, the child is replaced by it; if it returns None, the child is kept.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default
lib Library

The library object for storing symbols.

 required
transformer Callable[..., AST | None]

The function to call with each child node followed by the additional arguments.

 required
args object

Additional positional arguments passed to the transformer.

 ()
kwargs object

Additional keyword arguments passed to the transformer.

 {}

Returns:

Type Description
Self | None

A new node with the replaced children or None if no child was
Self | None

replaced.
